brief.headline: Massive Ukrainian drone strike on Moscow; Black Sea Fleet failures spark criticism
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels led with Ukraine's largest drone assault on Moscow in two years (430+ drones) and Crimea/Azov strikes, prompting unusually sharp criticism of the Black Sea Fleet and air defense, while claiming a village capture near Kupyansk as a bright spot.

developments.title: Ukraine launches 430+ drones at Moscow region
developments.body: Multiple channels reported Ukraine's largest drone attack on Moscow in two years, with 430+ drones and Russian MoD-claimed interception of the majority, including 36 near the capital. Two Majors separately cited 452 drones destroyed overnight nationwide. Claims unconfirmed and MoD-sourced.

developments.title: Azov tanker strikes and Crimea blackouts expose vulnerabilities
developments.body: Channels reported Ukrainian claims of eight shadow-fleet tankers hit in the Azov Sea carrying fuel for Crimea, plus widespread power outages across Crimea from drone strikes. Rybar framed Ukraine as 'systematically isolating' Crimea via ferries, fuel and energy infrastructure. Claims unconfirmed.

developments.title: Sharp criticism of Black Sea Fleet and air defense
developments.body: Rybar and Starshe Eddy openly criticized the Black Sea Fleet's inability to protect tankers and maritime commerce, calling for restructured naval command. NgP raZVedka claimed Iskander missiles struck Kyiv while Russian air defense 'was sleeping' and Titan systems failed — rare self-criticism of air defense performance.

developments.title: Claimed capture of Petro-Ivanovka near Kupyansk
developments.body: At least four channels claimed Russian forces (344th motorized rifle regiment) took Petro-Ivanovka in the Kharkiv region, allegedly forcing Ukraine to shift reserves and repelling 'Spanish-speaking mercenaries.' Unconfirmed and not independently verified.

developments.title: Kherson declares emergency over strike-related power outages
developments.body: Two Majors reported the Kherson governor declared an emergency regime due to widespread outages affecting 207 populated areas from Ukrainian strikes, underscoring energy-infrastructure vulnerability on the Russian-controlled side.

developments.title: NATO Ankara summit and rearmament framed as escalation
developments.body: Channels reported a NATO summit in Ankara excluding Ukraine, alongside claims of depleted Patriot stocks, a $40bn 'NATO Drone Edge' anti-drone initiative, European rearmament plans for four million shells annually, and Poland cutting aid by 90%. Figures channel-sourced and unverified.

narrative_watch.title: Self-criticism of naval command and air defense
narrative_watch.body: Unusually candid frame this day: Black Sea Fleet cannot protect tankers, EW ineffective against drones, and air defense 'sleeping' — channels demand command restructuring rather than deflecting blame.

narrative_watch.title: Ukrainian strikes as terrorism against civilians
narrative_watch.body: Channels repeatedly frame Ukrainian drone/missile strikes on Belgorod, Luhansk and buses as deliberate civilian targeting and 'terrorism,' while attributing Russian strikes to legitimate infrastructure/logistics targets.

narrative_watch.title: Blaming Ukraine for its own casualties
narrative_watch.body: NgP raZVedka and Poddubny push a line that a struck Kyiv site 'was not under military control,' implying Ukraine caused civilian harm through negligence — pre-emptively deflecting responsibility for Russian deep strikes.

mood_lines.text: Dominant topic (20 posts, net -60); alarm over Moscow drone swarm, Crimea blackouts and Azov tanker hits, though channels claim high interception rates.
Uniformly negative (net -100); Black Sea Fleet, air defense and civilian defense preparedness singled out for command failures.
Fully positive (net +100); Petro-Ivanovka capture claim and Konstantinovka/Zaporizhzhia advances presented as offensive momentum.
Strongly positive (net +89); fuel stations, Kryvyi Rih logistics and claimed 100% strike accuracy on Kyiv touted.
Negative (net -36); Ankara summit, rearmament and depleted Patriot stocks framed as both threat and evidence of Western fatigue.
Improved to net +29; fiber-optic drone development and charity/rescue stories offset by Kherson emergency outages.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment swings +29
flag_texts.body: Domestic-topic mood rose to net +29, driven by upbeat posts on a new fiber-optic attack drone (50-100km range, claimed operational) and charity/rescue stories, partly offsetting the negative Kherson outage news.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics quiet: mobilisation and Putin criticism
flag_texts.body: No posts on mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin this day; the day's criticism targeted the Black Sea Fleet, army command and civilian-sector defense readiness instead.
